parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-15 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1132.2 | 7.42 | 7.42
2 | 3621.5 | 17.67 | 25.09
3 | 4447.9 | 1.70 | 26.79
4 | 4307.5 | 0.53 | 27.32
5 | 7664.9 | 4.92 | 32.24
6 | 12762.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HKHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-15
Curve type: HKHA
Aquifer depth: 0 – 7.42 m
Recommendation: Groundwater potential at this location is very poor due to high resistivities and dense, resistive bedrock at shallow depths. Drilling is not recommended, but if necessary, operations should focus solely on the thin, shallow weathered overburden.
